headline: Executive session and possible approval of candidates for Interim Lyman Hall High School Assistant Principal and Business Manager Position.
summary: The board will meet in executive session to interview and discuss candidates for Interim Lyman Hall High School Assistant Principal and for the Business Manager position. The board will then discuss and may approve appointment of candidates for both positions.
items: Executive session: interviews and discussion of candidates for Interim Lyman Hall High School Assistant Principal
Executive session: discussion of candidates for Business Manager Position
Discussion and possible approval of appointment of candidate for Interim Lyman Hall High School Assistant Principal
Discussion and possible approval of appointment of candidate for Business Manager Position
location: Board of Education Conference Room, 4 Fairfield Boulevard, Wallingford
